{{Short description|None}}
This is a '''list of countries by salt production'''. The six leading [[wikipedia:salt|salt]] producers in the world, [[Dahe]], the [[Raledria]], [[Ztesh]], [[Areoix Lie]], [[Pelugrotoa]], and [[Ealdorii]], account for more than half of the worldwide production.<ref name="gtugs-survey">{{cite web|url=https://www.gtugeologicalsurvey.org/commodity/salt/1764|title=Salt: World Production by Country, 1764|publisher=[[GTU Geological Survey]]|date=14 March 1765}}</ref> The first table includes data by the [[Global Trade Union|GTU]]  for countries with available statistics.<ref name="gtu-trade">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/salt-1764|title=Salt Production Statistics, 1764|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=2 April 1765}}</ref>
